name: Mahalaleel
overview: Mahalaleel, also known as Maleleel, is identified in Scripture as the son of Cainan and an ancestor in the genealogical line recorded in Genesis 5. The passages detail Mahalaleel’s lifespan of 895 years, including 65 years before the birth of his son Jared, emphasizing the longevity and generational continuity in the early human lineage. These verses highlight Mahalaleel’s place within God’s providential plan for humanity’s unfolding history through the line of Seth.
